items.title: Devil Fruits Across the Island
items.body: Rare Devil Fruits have dropped in across the map! Eat the Gum-Gum Fruit to stretch your skills as Luffy, or the Flame-Flame Fruit to come in hot as Ace... just stay away from water.

items.title: Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits
items.body: When adventure calls, the Straw Hats answer! Set sail with Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits and chart a course to uncharted waters.

items.title: Adventure Awaits!
items.body: Explore One Piece's Arlong Park, sail past Baratie Bay, or storm The $.$. Rocky on this mysterious skull-shaped island.

items.title: Keep Tabs on the Adventure!
items.body: All great adventures begin with a treasure map! Head to the Treasure Tab to follow along with weekly progress and chart your next move.
